descriptions.d31j_add_named_target_80179b24: When a non-empty name is given: creates the template, names and binds it to the shared reference (returning 0x80004005 on failure), creates two more objects and appends them to the three compact reference arrays, links them and notifies the manager; otherwise appends three null references. Then appends the item to the engine array, attaches it and updates its target entry.
